title: Neighbors in a network (Graphology)
description: Graphology stores an original undirected network and queries neighbors and degrees. Choose a node to highlight exactly its immediate connections.
description_ko: Graphology에 직접 만든 무방향 관계망을 저장하고 이웃과 연결 수를 질의해요. 노드를 고르면 바로 연결된 이웃만 밝혀요.
prompt: Neighbors in a network. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
